dedupe_keys.name: arcgis for pipeline asset management with the utility and pipeline data model updm

description: Esri markets ArcGIS for full life-cycle pipeline asset management, applying geography to the collection, organisation and analysis of asset data to improve decisions and activity management and to provide a single source of truth for staff. The page states that creating and maintaining a digital twin of the in-ground pipe network and its surroundings is essential, that once pipes are buried the digital twin becomes the primary authoritative record of assets, and that ArcGIS can integrate digital twins from many sources; it discusses how detailed a gas network definition should be to support the full range of uses. The lead named Esri's Utility and Pipeline Data Model (UPDM), which this page does not describe; partner tools such as SheetCutter Pro state they work with UPDM. Coverage: any pipeline system. Format and access: licensed desktop, enterprise and online GIS. Licence and cost: paid, under Esri licences. Caveats: a marketing overview without technical specifications of the data model on this page. It supports digital twin and hazard exposure work on pipeline networks, such as overlaying hazards on a pipeline GIS. It relates to SheetCutter Pro, the Express Loader for PODS data and QGIS in the catalogue.
